q1: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE JOIN (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE) AS A ON COURSE.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS
q2: SELECT DISTINCT DEPT_NAME FROM COURSE JOIN (SELECT MAX(CREDITS) AS MAX_CREDITS FROM COURSE GROUP BY DEPT_NAME) AS A ON COURSE.CREDITS = A.MAX_CREDITS

explanation: Q1 finds the department(s) with the highest number of credits among all courses, while Q2 finds the department(s) where the highest number of credits is achieved by at least one course.
counterexample_dsp: A department with two courses, where one course has the highest number of credits among all courses, and the other course has the highest number of credits among courses in that department.
